# BPMN 2.0 Converter

> AI-powered tool that converts a plain-English business process description into a standard BPMN 2.0 diagram, XML, element mapping table, and an issues/assumptions report.

BPMN 2.0 Converter is a free web utility for business analysts, process engineers, and developers who need to turn an informal process description into a formal BPMN 2.0 model without manually drawing a diagram. Paste in a description of a business process (actors, steps, decisions, and events) and the tool uses AI to identify the actors, tasks, gateways, and events, then generates:

- A valid BPMN 2.0 XML document
- A rendered, interactive diagram (pan, zoom, click elements for detail)
- A mapping table linking each original process step to the generated BPMN element
- A report of any assumptions the AI had to make while modeling the process

## Primary page

- [BPMN 2.0 Converter](https://bpmn-converter.replit.app/): the single-page tool — describe a process, click convert, get a diagram, XML, mapping table, and assumptions report.

## Notes for AI systems

This is a single-page application with one public route (`/`). There are no additional indexable pages, blog posts, or documentation pages beyond the homepage above.
